proof_body:
by
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have he := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hne : Real.pi / Real.exp 1 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq he.ne'] at h
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    have := Real.pi_gt_three
    linarith
  have h := Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hpi he) hne
  rw [Real.log_div hpi.ne' he.ne', Real.log_exp] at h
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hpi]
  apply Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr
  have h2 : Real.log Real.pi < Real.pi / Real.exp 1 := by linarith
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ he] at h2
  exact h2
